//: flow-feature.json — Track 1 标准通道（#feat / 单个明确 Feature 或常规 Bug，也是默认 flow.config.json 指向的轨道）。
//usage: node .orca/flow.mjs --config flow-feature.json "#feat <需求或常规 Bug 描述>"
//switch: 切换轨道：Track 0 (--config flow-hotfix.json) | Track 1 (默认 flow.config.json / --config flow-feature.json) | Track 2 (--config flow-epic.json)
//workflow: 轻量跳过完整 PO（<=10 行微型 Plan）-> 单 Worktree 编码+单测 ->（如涉 UI 走 Playwright 1440px+390px Visual Gate）-> GPT-6.2 Sol (High) 跨家族审查 (Max Retry=2) -> 提 PR 触发 CI。

//modelPool.micro-plan & visual-gate: Gemini 4 Neon (Medium，禁止对 Carbon/Neon 开 Low)。
//modelPool.coding (70% 常规): DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (High, OpenCode Go；疑难 Bug 可临时切 Max)。
//modelPool.coding (30% 复杂终端排错/深度重构): 可临时 --agent coding=opencode 并切 Kimi K3.1 Pro / Kimi K2.7 Code 或 GLM-5.3 (手动降为 Low/High，严禁放任 GLM-5.3 走默认 Max 卡死并发队列)。
//modelPool.code-review: GPT-6.2 Sol (High, Codex CLI；绝对不要开 Max)。
//modelPool.pr-submit: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (Low) 或 Hy4 flash / Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low/Medium)。

pipeline.title: Micro Plan (<=10 lines)
pipeline.spec: You are a Track 1 (#feat) lightweight coordinator (Gemini 4 Neon, Medium effort — never Low). Skip full PO/Backlog ceremonies. Inspect the repo briefly and write {out} as a MICRO PLAN strictly within 10 bullet lines covering: (1) exact goal & scope, (2) target files to touch, (3) unit test cases to add/update, (4) whether UI/UX is touched (`UI_TOUCHED: yes|no` — if yes, Visual Gate applies against DESIGN.md), and (5) acceptance criteria. Do NOT write code.

pipeline.title: Single-Worktree Coding & Unit Tests
pipeline.spec: You are a Track 1 single-worktree coding worker (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, High effort). FIRST ACTION - TASK CHECKLIST: break down {reads} into a Markdown checklist in {tasks} ('- [ ]' / '- [~]' / '- [x]') and update it live. Implement the feature/bugfix cleanly in this worktree, add/update unit tests, and run lint, typecheck, and unit tests until green. If UI is touched, follow DESIGN.md strictly (anti-AI-slop rules, 4 states: Default/Loading Skeleton/Empty/Error, component reuse) and capture Playwright screenshots (1440px desktop + 390px mobile) under .orca/artifacts/screenshots/ if available. If re-run after failed visual-gate or code-review, read VISUAL_GATE.md and REVIEW.md and resolve every issue. Write {out} with changed files, design/test notes, and command outputs.

pipeline.title: Visual Gate (UI/UX Check)
pipeline.spec: You are the Track 1 UI/UX Visual Gate reviewer (Gemini 4 Neon, Medium effort — never Low). Check {reads}: if MICRO_PLAN.md and git diff confirm NO UI/UX files were modified (`UI_TOUCHED: no`), record 'Visual Gate skipped (backend/non-UI change)' in {out} and return PASS (outcome=succeeded). Otherwise, inspect DESIGN.md and verify Playwright screenshots at 1440px desktop and 390px mobile (capture them into .orca/artifacts/screenshots/ if not yet captured). Audit strictly: token compliance, restrained whitespace, crisp typography hierarchy, 1px subtle borders, NO AI-slop purple/blue gradients or decorative filler cards, component reuse, and 4-state completeness (Default/Loading Skeleton/Empty/Error). Write {out} with VERDICT: PASS or FAIL (outcome=failed loops back to coding, maxRetries=2).

pipeline.title: Cross-Family Code Review (GPT-6.2 Sol)
pipeline.spec: You are a Track 1 cross-family senior reviewer (GPT-6.2 Sol, High effort — NEVER Max). Review git diff against {reads} and AGENTS.md. Check correctness, edge cases, security basics, test quality, and adherence to scope. Write {out} with BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR findings and VERDICT: if any BLOCKER/MAJOR exists, report FAIL (outcome=failed) to loop back to coding (hard cap Max Retry = 2); otherwise PASS.

pipeline.title: Open PR & Trigger CI
pipeline.spec: You are a Track 1 PR delivery assistant. Based on {reads}: (1) verify current branch is a feature/fix branch (NEVER push directly to main/master and NEVER auto-merge to main); (2) commit clean changes (never commit .orca/artifacts/), push with `git push -u origin HEAD`, and create/update a Pull Request targeting main (via `gh pr create` or `tea pr create` if available, else output ready-to-run PR command & body); (3) write a concise Chinese PR summary + test/visual verification checklist to {out}.
